commands.command: git fetch -q origin mvp/environment-controller && test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "d9383a693f66851f5151a96f0341fd4eeaaf746d" && test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "d9383a693f66851f5151a96f0341fd4eeaaf746d" && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"

printf '%s
' '=== SERIAL PORTS ==='; ls -l /dev/cu.usbserial-* /dev/cu.wchusbserial* /dev/cu.usbmodem* 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s
' '=== USB DEVICES ==='; system_profiler SPUSBDataType 2>/dev/null | grep -E -A12 -B2 'USB Serial|CH34|CP210|ESP32|Espressif|wch|QinHeng|Silicon Labs' || true; printf '%s
' '=== TARGET PROBE ==='; test -e /dev/cu.usbserial-1130 || { echo 'GROWBOX_PORT_IDENTIFICATION_FAIL expected_port_missing=/dev/cu.usbserial-1130 forbidden_port_untouched=/dev/cu.usbserial-10'; exit 3; }; if command -v esptool.py >/dev/null 2>&1; then ESPTOOL=esptool.py; elif command -v esptool >/dev/null 2>&1; then ESPTOOL=esptool; else ESPTOOL="$HOME/.espressif/python_env/idf5.5_py3.13_env/bin/python -m esptool"; fi; eval "$ESPTOOL --port /dev/cu.usbserial-1130 chip_id"; echo 'GROWBOX_PORT_IDENTIFICATION_PASS port=/dev/cu.usbserial-1130 forbidden_port_untouched=/dev/cu.usbserial-10 flash_started=0 rf_started=0'
